read.en: The Nasdaq ADS rose 4.1% on Oct 26 to $142.62, trading between $139.15 and $143.47, with no 100-day average yet (76 sessions). It is above the falling 5-day ($138.9) and level with the falling 10-day ($142.4), and below the falling 30-day ($169.8). MACD has been below its signal since Sep 28 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 7 ($151.91), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 10月26日上涨 4.1%，收于 $142.62，盘中区间 $139.15–143.47；上市仅 76 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$138.9）上方，与下行的 10 日均线（$142.4）持平，低于下行的 30 日均线（$169.8）。MACD 自 9月28日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月7日起看空（$151.91），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The rebound cleared $137.1–138.9 (Oct 15 and 20 lows, 5-day), now support. Resistance is $143.5 (Oct 26 high), then $146–146.4 (Oct 15 and 21 highs) and $151.9 (SAR). Support is $137.1–139.2 (5-day, Oct 26 low), then $133.8–135.2 (Aug 7 and Oct 23 lows) and $130.8 (Oct 22 low). A close above $146.4 would target $148–152; a close below $137 would reopen $134.

s.en: 5-day average $138.9; Oct 26 low $139.2; Oct 15 and Oct 20 lows ($137.1–137.8), cleared

bias.en: Bearish · rebound faded at the SAR
bias.zh: 偏空 · 反弹在 SAR 处回落

read.en: SK hynix closed at ₩1,275,000 in Seoul on Oct 26, little changed from ₩1,277,000, after a ₩1,267,000–1,315,000 range. It is above the falling 5-day (₩1,268,800) and below the falling 10-day (₩1,279,700), 30-day (₩1,599,600) and 100-day (₩1,858,360) and the rising 200-day (₩1,480,590). MACD has been below its signal and zero since Oct 5, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 28 (₩1,315,000), and RSI is 33.

The intraday push reached the SAR at ₩1,315,000 and faded; ₩1.25 million support held. Resistance is ₩1.28 million (10-day, Oct 23 high), then ₩1,315,000 (Oct 26 high, SAR) and ₩1.33 million (October highs). Support is ₩1,267,000–1,268,800 (Oct 26 low, 5-day), then ₩1.25 million (Jul 29 low) and ₩1,171,000 (Oct 23 low). A close above ₩1,315,000 would target ₩1.33 million; below ₩1.25 million, ₩1,171,000.
read.zh: 盘中冲高至 SAR 所在的 ₩1,315,000 后回落；125 万韩元支撑守住。阻力为 128 万韩元（10 日均线、10月23日高点），其次 ₩1,315,000（10月26日高点、SAR）和 133 万韩元（10 月高点）。支撑为 ₩1,267,000–1,268,800（10月26日低点、5 日均线），其次 125 万韩元（7月29日低点）和 ₩1,171,000（10月23日低点）。若收盘站上 ₩1,315,000，下一目标看 133 万韩元；若跌破 125 万韩元，则看 ₩1,171,000。
